proves.claim: A land receipt posted through boardJobQueueCall that lands a sprint item queues one main-wide test job on the landed tip, carrying the land job and its sprint items, and a runner claims it with claimJob.

api.gate.post-land-main-test.queues-one.why: Without it nothing runs main's tests after a sprint landing, so a test the landed work broke is seen only by a hand command.

proves.claim: A second receipt for the same landed tip, from the same land job or another, queues no second test job.

api.gate.post-land-main-test.once-per-ti.why: One tip needs one main-wide run; duplicates would spend runner time on the same answer.

proves.claim: A land job with only steady items queues no job and prepares the same board calls with a builder as with none, and a board with no builder queues none for a sprint landing.

api.gate.post-land-main-test.steady-unch.why: Sprint wiring must change nothing for steady landings.
